text:
maria_w: Heads-up: console observability roadmap decision thread. Need final scope for Q3/OKR. TL;DR: pick retention window, tracing sampling strategy, core dashboards, and launch criteria. Customers pushing for retention + advanced error grouping.

ajay_k: Can we list must-have vs nice-to-have? I think must: per-route latency, token cost breakdown, basic error groups (fingerprinting). Nice: deep traces UI, session replay, custom retention policies.

lucy_o: From support: FinCorp and HealthCo require 90d with KMS-backed logs. If we go 30d default, offer paid 90d? Also need export hooks.

thomas_s: SRE constraints: storage ops cost jumps ~x3 when we go >30d. We need compaction + cold storage plan. Also need retention purge job SLA.

mina_d: For tracing, recommended default sampling 1% with adaptive increase on errors. Proposed config:
```
tracing:
  default_sampling: 0.01
  error_boost: true
  per_route_overrides: true
```

ajay_k: Perf target: dashboard load <700ms for p95 for 30d. For 90d maybe async loading + pagination. Need backend endpoints: /api/obs/metrics?range=; design in PR #432.

maria_w: Launch criteria proposal: (1) Dashboards: latency+cost+errors working end-to-end (2) Traces: ingest + UI with sampling + error-triggered capture (3) Retention: 30d default + enterprise opt-in 90d with KMS + export (4) Observability docs and migration guide.

lucy_o: Sounds reasonable. Can we make 90d gated behind Dedicated/Private only? That satisfies compliance customers without blowing hosted costs.

thomas_s: Agree. Also require A/B rollout and budget guardrails. If traffic spikes, auto-fallback to 30d for hosted.

ajay_k: MVP scope: dashboards (3 widgets), error grouping, traces ingest + 1 view, retention 30d default. Stretch: traces waterfall, trace search, 90d enterprise.

maria_w: OK I'll call that MVP. @ajay_k can you write acceptance criteria and link to product PR? @mina_d please mock the tracing sample UI. @lucy_o update customer comms.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduling roadmap sync scheduled on 1769880000 (Fri) 15:00 UTC — calendar invite sent.

mina_d: Quick Q: do we need E2E eval hooks for quality regressions? e.g., alerts when error rate increases after model rollout.

maria_w: Yes include as a must for Optimize integration — add 'regression alerting' to launch criteria.

ajay_k: :thumbsup: I'll get a draft of API + perf targets by tomorrow. I'll also add a rough cost estimate for 90d.

lucy_o: Thanks — I'll prep customer notes and get buy-in from FinCorp.
